site.name: North San Jose / Alviso compute site (illustrative 150 MW)

disclaimer: Directional inputs for search and Lean rules. GRIP is not guaranteed; pending load withheld; not a PG&E approval.

search_space.note: From ORCH 13:24 / L3 brief. Bank caps exist for every curtailment_pct listed.

rule_inputs.R_bank_cap: sum(MW on feeders with the same bank_id) <= banks[].cap_mw_by_curtailment_pct[c] (feeder hosting is NOT additive)
rule_inputs.R_curtail_window: a plan with curtailment c commits to banks[].curtail_cells_by_pct[c] (local Aug-Sep afternoons), not the CAISO system window
rule_inputs.R_flood: flood_sfha true -> permit/cost condition (equipment above BFE), not auto-RED
rule_inputs.R_transmission: MW not placed on distribution needs transmission service: 7-10 years (organizers) > deadline 2028-06-30 -> RED for that share unless deadline relaxed
